svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Hang: Set your hinge and let your arms hang long under your shoulders.
svg.title: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Hang: Set your hinge and let your arms hang long under your shoulders.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Pull: Pull both dumbbells toward your hips while holding your torso still.
svg.title: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Pull: Pull both dumbbells toward your hips while holding your torso still.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Top: Briefly hold both dumbbells near your hips with your elbows back.
svg.title: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Top: Briefly hold both dumbbells near your hips with your elbows back.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Lower: Lower under control until your arms are long again.
svg.title: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row, Lower: Lower under control until your arms are long again.
